en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 stays overnight; Saudel 350 km east at 8pm
en.dek: Tropical Storm Saudel was centred about 350 kilometres east of Hong Kong at 8pm and is expected to linger over the northeastern South China Sea through Thursday morning.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Standby Signal No. 1 remains in force and is expected to stay until at least Thursday morning as Tropical Storm Saudel continues to track across the northeastern South China Sea.

At 8pm on Wednesday the storm was located about 350 kilometres east of Hong Kong near 22.6 degrees north and 117.6 degrees east, moving northeast at about 10 kilometres per hour with maximum sustained winds near the centre of 65 kilometres per hour.

The Observatory said Saudel is forecast to linger over the northeastern South China Sea tonight and into Thursday morning, maintaining a distance of roughly 300 kilometres or more from the territory. Under the combined influence of the storm and the northeast monsoon, winds are occasionally strong offshore and on high ground.

According to the present forecast, Saudel is expected to gradually turn westwards on Thursday, skirting the coast of eastern Guangdong and edging closer to the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary around Friday. There are rather large uncertainties in its intensity by then, and the Observatory will continue to assess the need for a Strong Wind Signal No. 3.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號通宵維持 沙德爾晚上8時位於本港以東約350公里
zh.dek: 熱帶風暴沙德爾晚上8時位於本港以東約350公里，預料今晚至周四早上在南海東北部徘徊，與本港保持約300公里或以上距離。
body: 香港天文台表示，一號戒備信號繼續生效，預料至少維持至周四早上。熱帶風暴沙德爾仍在南海東北部移動。
周三晚上8時，沙德爾集結在北緯22.6度、東經117.6度附近，即香港以東約350公里，向東北移動，時速約10公里，中心附近最高持續風速每小時65公里。
天文台指，沙德爾預料今晚至周四早上在南海東北部徘徊，與本港保持約300公里或以上距離。受沙德爾與東北季候風共同影響，本港離岸及高地間中吹強風。
按照現時預測，沙德爾周四會逐漸轉向偏西方向移動，掠過廣東東部沿岸，並在周五再度靠近珠江口一帶，但屆時強度存在相當大變數。天文台會密切監察其動向，評估是否需要改發三號強風信號。
